[DEBUG] detect_anomalies SQL:

        WITH Stats AS (
            SELECT finance_line_subtype as Cat, AVG(expense_amount) as AvgVal
            FROM `strong-kit-475107-k1.fpaa_dataset.Expenses`
            WHERE month_period = '2025-11-01'
            GROUP BY 1
        )
        SELECT 
            t.location, 
            t.finance_line_subtype as Item, 
            t.expense_amount as Amount, 
            s.AvgVal
        FROM `strong-kit-475107-k1.fpaa_dataset.Expenses` t
        JOIN Stats s ON t.finance_line_subtype = s.Cat
        WHERE t.month_period = '2025-11-01'
        AND t.expense_amount > (s.AvgVal * 3) -- The "3x" Outlier Rule
        ORDER BY t.expense_amount DESC
        LIMIT 5
